html: Here is the new video trailer for my bestselling Rho Agenda series. Turn up the sound and enjoy.

comments.author: thelastbesthope
comments.html: The Rho Agenda is as good as it gets if you love sci-fi that takes us far away … while placing us on the cutting edge of AI potential today.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Many thanks. Glad you like it. I look forward to following up on the series as soon as I finish my Endarian Prophecy.

comments.author: Paula Hammond
comments.html: I’m a 66 year old women who can’t get enough good Sci Fi! Loved the Rho Agenda books, especially the “Second Ship”. When will they continue? Seems like you opened a great opportunity for many more books.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Paula. This year I will finish the final three books in my epic fantasy series, The Endarian Prophecy. Immediately thereafter, I plan on a spinoff from the Rho Agenda Series. Glad you enjoyed the nine books in that series.
Best,
Richard

comments.author: Steve Carter
comments.html:
Dear Mr Phillips
I’m in love with your series’s starting with the Second Ship. That said I lost the narrative after the third book. Did the story about the 3 friends, one child and Ripper continue?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Steve,
Thank you for that. Yes it did and is still continuing with my latest Rho novel in the works. The books immediately following The Second Ship, Immune, and Wormhole are The Kasari Nexus, The Altreian Enigma, and The Meridian Ascent. After having taken a break to do my Endarian Prophecy Fantasy series, I am hard at work on a new spinoff from the Rho Agenda series (working title: The Ripper’s Son). Thank you for your interest.
Best,
Richard

replies.author: kidviborg@yahoo.com
replies.html:
I also love your fantasy stories. I’m an old geezer at 76 and your imagination and story telling is magic. Steve Carter

>

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Hey, as an old geezer myself… 65… I appreciate you. Life is about enjoying every moment we have above the dirt. Carol, my wife of 41 years, and I certainly do. Thank you for following my stories. And if you, and any other of my fans, pass through Phoenix, please email me. I love to meet with you guys for lunch or coffee. [email removed]
